selector: minimum original terminal point-plus-box oracle calls on the full validation workload plus standalone label acquisition; feasible qualified services only; lexicographic ties
selector_limitation: This declared operation-count criterion is not a measured wall-time optimum or a price-calibrated adoption rule. Readout arithmetic, fitting, all-menu validation, rejected proposals, independent audits and interrupted executions remain separate charged resource categories.
execution_note: Tool time limits interrupted processes after complete rows. The canonical validation keeps every unique completed row under the same frozen common oracle, and resumes missing design keys. The earlier unamended 54-row run is retained separately and not pooled. Interruptions and their incompletely measured work are retained, not relabeled zero-cost or successful whole runs.
